description.en:
Removes the building restrictions on vanilla modules

Unlike the original no restrictions mod made by Zark, I will (try) to keep this mod as up to date as possible with the stable build of the game.

If anyone finds any modules that still have their restrictions or any other bugs, just DM me over discord or tell me in the comments below.

--Known problems--
When Yellows Dependencies is turned on, the landship propulsion and a great deal of other modules keep their restrictions. If you wish to use said mod along side this one, subscribe to this addon: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2355845161

Ver:2.1.1

--Changelog for 2.1.2--
- Removed restrictions on the Nest of Bees weapon
